mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url, p.gender, p.birth_date, p.region, p.occupation, p.bio, p.belief_years, p.church_name, p.ministry_role, p.seeking_gender, p.seeking_age_min, p.seeking_age_max, p.seeking_region, p.photos, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courtship_profiles(id, user_id, nickname, gender, birth_date, region, occupation, bio, belief_years, church_name, ministry_role, seeking_gender, seeking_age_min, seeking_age_max, seeking_region, photos, status) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{region}, #{occupation}, #{bio}, #{beliefYears}, #{churchName}, #{ministryRole}, #{seekingGender}, #{seekingAgeMin}, #{seekingAgeMax}, #{seekingRegion}, #{photos}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE courtship_profiles SET nickname = #{nickname}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, region = #{region}, occupation = #{occupation}, bio = #{bio}, belief_years = #{beliefYears}, church_name = #{churchName}, ministry_role = #{ministryRole}, seeking_gender = #{seekingGender}, seeking_age_min = #{seekingAgeMin}, seeking_age_max = #{seekingAgeMax}, seeking_region = #{seekingRegion}, photos = #{photos}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, nickname, gender, birth_date, region, occupation, bio, belief_years, church_name, ministry_role, seeking_gender, seeking_age_min, seeking_age_max, seeking_region, photos, status, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM courtship_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT , EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM courtship_likes cl WHERE cl.from_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND cl.to_user_id = p.user_id) AS liked_by_me FROM courtship_profiles p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
